stem: At an internet café, the charge for using a computer is 5 cents per minute. The number of minutes for which people use a computer has mean 23 and standard deviation 8.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find, in cents, the mean and standard deviation of the amount people pay when using a computer.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Each day, 15 people use computers independently. Find, in cents, the mean and standard deviation of the total amount paid by 15 people.
